v4.6.124 — Live trading (real money) support

⚠ You can now run with REAL MONEY. Flip the header ○ paper → ◉ LIVE toggle (it asks you to confirm). In LIVE mode:

• Bots trade your real Alpaca account using separate live API keys — enter them in Tools → Alpaca API Keys (the slots switch to live keys automatically). Cloud bots now receive the live keys too.

• The PORTFOLIO tab shows your real-money Alpaca account — enter its live key + secret in the tab when prompted. A red 'LIVE · REAL MONEY' badge makes the mode obvious.

Nothing trades real money until you add live keys AND switch the toggle to LIVE — paper stays the default.

Update via the in-app banner.
